acceptanceCriteria: Console refuses a document with exact spec cem/1.0 plus a case-variant Spec member naming cem/0.3 before drawing hunks; stable parse errors cannot enter legacy display or lose the NOT_RUN stable envelope.

A report emitted by CompileStable and Canonical verifies with unchanged bytes and inputs after ordinary encoding/json.Unmarshal into Report; changed semantics still fail report-mismatch and artifact drift still refuses.
Non-stable StableCEMProjection inputs return corpus-stable-refused plus a REFUSED receipt, no claims, and the complete stable verifier refusal result as required by CEM-V1-076.
Add regression tests for these paths; preserve 0.x golden bytes and do not encode, reduce or relabel the stable map.
body: Confirmed review defects in V1-0632 S5c at aca36474e5acd923dcbdfcec21b5776bacce9e06, range a8c05c4f45a8971665ee97d2eada7c739a0e0d14..HEAD. Runtime go1.27.2 darwin; installed Core 1.0.0-rc.3 build 407, Tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.407. Disposable Go overlay tests used the existing public sealed positive fixture and were removed afterward. 1) internal/console/chain.go:331 selects strict parsing after permissive encoding/json decoding: injecting an additional "Spec":"cem/0.3" after "spec":"cem/1.0" leaves wire.DeclaresStable=true and ParseStable rejects unknown member, but decodeSealed admits profile=cem/0.3 with two hunks. 2) internal/witnesscollapse/stable.go:101 DeepEqual rejects an emitted report after Canonical and json.Unmarshal because verification References criterionBindings changes from []wire.StableCriterion to []interface{} (and untyped hunk values change representation); reproduction returned report-mismatch with no semantic edits. 3) internal/doccorpus/cem_stable.go:36-37 returns nil receipt for {"spec":"cem/0.3"}; the error is corpus-stable-refused but REFUSED/no-claims/full-verifier-result envelope required by CEM-V1-076 is absent. Existing new tests do not exercise these cases: console tests inject lower-case extra only, collapse verifies only the in-memory report, and non-stable corpus test checks only err != nil. Focused go vet and git diff --check passed. This ticket records review findings only; it does not authorize promotion or declare V1-0632 complete.

completion.reason: S5c Codex round-1 findings fixed: the console refuses case-variant and duplicate Spec members before drawing hunks; a CompileStable report verifies after an ordinary JSON round trip; non-stable StableCEMProjection inputs return corpus-stable-refused with a REFUSED receipt. Regression tests added. Codex round 3 PASS; CEM-V1-070..079 accepted. The remaining P3 (no graph-invalid, wire-valid fixture for retained witness counts) is recorded in the build log. Delivered in beamfall/corvint#817, merged to main at 9495d8b44. Tests on go1.27.2: receiptbundle, cem/..., lrfrepo, lrf, witness, witnesscollapse, console, conformance/ocm-v0, filtered doccorpus and cmd/corvint PASS; go vet clean; doc gates PASS; CEM check and seal PASS. full-gate (make gate) NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the lane build-log record at the merge commit.
